name: Spider hand icon
description: UI slot icon for the spider hand: three arms fanned off one knuckle, caught mid-reach. Composes ss.lib.spider-arm three times rather than drawing a leg three times, so the slot, the two finds and the evolution all show the same limb. The rim is bile, the one colour no other slot in the game wears — a venom green for the only weapon that gets hold of things.

evolved.description: Widow's Grip. The rim goes gold the way every evolved slot in the roster does, but the three limbs are swapped out for ss.lib.spider-arm-widow — banded, spurred, hooked on three toes, bruised purple carrying blood — rather than recoloured, because the evolution changes what the arm is and not just what colour it is. Same fan, same knuckle, same three angles, so the two slots read as one weapon at two ages.
